crossRefs.note: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man…
For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to…
For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is…
There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his…
The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him…
This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

translations.web: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
translations.bsb: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe the task that one performs on the earth—though his eyes do not see sleep in the day or even in the night—
translations.kjv: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
translations.asv: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes),
